task: Add MCPErrorCategory enum and MCPBridgeError exception for typed error classification, inject category-specific diagnostic hints in MCPServerTester.test(), fix the ValueError sanitizer gap in toolkit_service.py, and add regression tests for all new error paths.

key_reasoning.reason: Three distinct components touched across three layers: models.py (MCPErrorCategory enum + MCPBridgeError exception), client.py (raise typed exception with category assignment), and toolkit_service.py (MCPServerTester.test() category-specific hint branching + _sanitize_exception_for_log() update). Coordination is required across all three but scope is contained within the MCP subsystem.

The key risk is subtle: MCPBridgeError must NOT subclass ValueError because _sanitize_exception_for_log() in toolkit_service.py strips ValueError message bodies to the type name only, which would silently reintroduce the diagnostic gap this task is meant to fix. The pattern itself (enum + typed exception) is standard Python, but getting the inheritance chain wrong produces a hard-to-detect regression.
